title: Week 06 — same Owner, same subscription, same SKU. One delete is refused.
alt: Architecture diagram. A deployment stack created at the mg-lz-dev management group carries denySettingsMode denyWriteAndDelete, and it lives ABOVE the subscription on purpose so a Contributor inside the subscription cannot reach it to lift its own restriction. The stack places a deny assignment on one of two otherwise identical storage accounts in the lab subscription. The control storage account, built by Terraform with no protection, is deleted successfully. The protected one, deployed from ARM JSON and owned by the stack, refuses the same delete with DenyAssignmentAuthorizationFailed, attempted by the same signed-in Owner.
